componentLibrary.name: BEAST 2.8 (sample)
componentLibrary.description: A hand-written sample of BEAST 2.8 package components, to exercise loading an engine library beside PhyloSpec core. Covers the BICEPS package (BICEPS, YuleSkyline) and the bModelTest package.

types.name: BModelSet
types.description: A named set of nucleotide substitution models to average over.

generators.name: BICEPS
generators.description: Bayesian Integrated Coalescent Epoch PlotS: a skyline plot that integrates out population sizes under an inverse gamma prior.

arguments.name: populationShape
arguments.description: Shape of the inverse gamma prior on population sizes.

arguments.name: populationMean
arguments.description: Mean of the inverse gamma prior on population sizes.

arguments.name: groupCount
arguments.description: Number of epochs.

arguments.name: ploidy
arguments.description: Copy number for the gene.

arguments.name: linkedMean
arguments.description: Use populationMean for the first epoch only, taking later means from the previous epoch.

arguments.name: equalEpochs
arguments.description: Use epochs of equal length rather than epochs based on groups.

arguments.name: taxa
arguments.description: The taxa of the tree.

generators.name: YuleSkyline
generators.description: Skyline version of the Yule tree prior, integrating out birth rates under a gamma prior.

arguments.name: birthRateShape
arguments.description: Shape of the gamma prior on birth rates.

arguments.name: birthRateRate
arguments.description: Rate of the gamma prior on birth rates.

arguments.name: groupCount
arguments.description: Number of epochs.

arguments.name: equalEpochs
arguments.description: Use epochs of equal length rather than epochs based on groups.

arguments.name: taxa
arguments.description: The taxa of the tree.

generators.name: bModelSet
generators.description: The set of nucleotide substitution models named by a bModelTest model set.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: One of allreversible, transitionTransversionSplit, namedSimple, namedExtended.

generators.name: size
generators.description: The number of models in a model set.

arguments.name: modelSet
arguments.description: The model set.

generators.name: nucleotideModel
generators.description: The rate matrix selected from a model set by a model indicator. bModelTest samples the indicator, so the matrix itself stays deterministic.

arguments.name: modelSet
arguments.description: The set of models to choose from.

arguments.name: modelIndicator
arguments.description: Index of the model to use.

arguments.name: rates
arguments.description: Relative rates of the GTR process.

arguments.name: freq
arguments.description: Base frequencies.

arguments.name: meanRate
arguments.description: Overall rate of substitution.

generators.name: bSiteRates
generators.description: Site rates whose gamma shape and proportion of invariable sites are each switched on or off by an indicator, so that bModelTest averages over site models as well as rate matrices.

arguments.name: shape
arguments.description: Shape of the discretised gamma distribution.

arguments.name: numCategories
arguments.description: Number of rate categories.

arguments.name: proportionInvariable
arguments.description: Proportion of invariable sites.

arguments.name: useShape
arguments.description: Whether the non-zero site rates follow a discretised gamma.

arguments.name: useProportionInvariable
arguments.description: Whether a proportion of sites is invariable.

arguments.name: numSites
arguments.description: Number of sites.
